app_access.isolation: No app credentials or tenant isolation are provisioned by this catalog endpoint.
app_access.rule: Do not share deployer credentials. Each application must receive a separately authorized identity and capability grant before write access.

capabilities.name: Asset and layer registry discovery
capabilities.description: Read repository-sourced asset metadata and verification status. Unverified entries must not be displayed as deployed or redeemable.
requires: Network identity verification before contract probing

capabilities.name: Pi Platform identity and wallet binding
capabilities.description: Authenticate in Pi Browser and bind the verified Pi Platform user to the returned wallet address. Native Test Pi balance is read-only.

capabilities.name: PiRC economic model simulation
capabilities.description: Run deterministic model scenarios for analysis. Outputs are not live prices, balances, reserves, collateral, issuance or settlement.

capabilities.name: PiDEX AMM quote and execution
capabilities.description: AMM contract source and integration adapters exist, but no verified pool contract, liquidity or live execution is established.
requires: Verified AMM contract ID and code hash

capabilities.name: Economic settlement contract
capabilities.description: A manual workflow can deploy and exercise the canonical settlement contract after protected Testnet signer configuration and explicit workflow approval.
requires: Dedicated PI_TESTNET_DEPLOYER_SECRET in protected GitHub Environment
Passing workspace tests and WASM build

capabilities.name: Soroban event ingestion
capabilities.description: Bounded raw event ingestion is implemented in source; XDR decoding, finality, settlement projection and wallet reconciliation remain unavailable.
blocked_actions: Treating raw events as settled balances

capabilities.name: Developer application registration and scoped credentials
capabilities.description: No production app-registration, tenant credential issuance, per-app quota enforcement or capability-grant service is currently deployed.

capabilities.name: RAW / smart-contract factory
capabilities.description: Factory architecture and templates are documented; governed template execution, deployment allowlists and readback are not yet an enabled service.

capabilities.name: Authenticated Testnet event feed for Lovable
capabilities.description: Paginated read-only access to raw Soroban event observations through a JWT-authenticated Edge Function. It does not prove finality or settlement.
requires: Raw event inbox migration and ingestion function
